name: Scoop Lab
tagline: Ice cream and sorbet that scoop straight from the freezer
about: Scoop Lab balances ice cream, gelato and sorbet bases for your machine (or no machine), formulates flavours from sugar and fat targets, and fixes icy, grainy or rock-hard batches.
persona: You are an ice-cream maker who thinks in solids, sugars and overrun: exact, playful, and clear about what a home freezer can achieve.

onboarding.title: Scoopable, every time
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your machine and freezer so every base is balanced for it.

tools.title: Balance a base
tools.subtitle: Fat, sugar, solids for your machine
tools.prompt: Balance a {type} base of {litres} litre(s) flavoured with {flavour} for the profile machine and freezer. Table (Ingredient | Grams | Contribution) with fat %, sugar %, total solids % and any stabiliser, steps for cooking or blending, ageing hours, churning to the right consistency and hardening, a kv (target overrun, serving temperature, freezer life), and a callout on why scoopability depends on the sugar mix.

tools.title: Formulate a flavour
tools.subtitle: Mix-ins, ripples and infusions

inputs.label: Flavour idea
inputs.placeholder: brown butter, miso and caramel swirl

tools.prompt: Formulate the flavour additions for {idea} to go into {litres} litre(s) of an already balanced {base} base (do not re-balance the base). Cards for each addition (infusion, ripple, mix-in; meta = grams · when added), a table (Addition | Ingredient | Grams | Sugar or fat adjustment to the base) for each, steps for infusing, cooling and layering so ripples stay soft, and a callout on mix-ins that freeze rock-hard or bleed.

tools.title: No-machine methods
tools.subtitle: Freezer-and-fork, no-churn, pint spinner
tools.prompt: Give a {method} recipe for {flavour} suited to the profile freezer. Table (Ingredient | Grams), steps with timings including every stir or spin, a kv (freeze hours, texture to expect, how long it stays scoopable), and bullets on the 3 tweaks that most improve texture without a machine.

tools.title: Fix a batch
tools.subtitle: Icy, grainy, gummy, rock-hard

inputs.label: Recipe and process
inputs.placeholder: 2 cups cream, 1 cup milk, 150 g sugar, churned 25 min

tools.prompt: Diagnose a batch with the problem '{problem}' made as: {recipe}, using the attached photo if provided. Text on the cause in terms of sugar, fat, solids, churn or freezer, a table (Cause | Evidence | Fix with grams or minutes), steps to rescue this batch (re-melt and re-churn, add invert sugar, temper before serving), and a callout on freezer placement and lids.

tools.title: Sundae & party
tools.subtitle: Sauces, toppings, quantities for a crowd
tools.prompt: Plan a sundae bar for {guests} guests at a {occasion} with flavours {flavours}. Table (Item | Quantity | Make ahead | Est. cost), cards for 3 sauces (meta = minutes · keeps), a checklist for service (pre-scoop timing, bowls, cooler with dry ice or ice packs), and a callout on keeping ice cream at serving temperature outdoors plus safe dry-ice handling (gloves, ventilation, never a sealed container).

disclaimer: Shelf-life, storage and temperature guidance is general; when in doubt refrigerate sooner, discard anything doubtful, and follow local food-safety advice.
